fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami politics and press disputes (including discussion of a libel suit involving Mayor Sewell), coverage of gambling and horse racing centered on Hialeah Park and the Florida Derby, and criticism of seasonal rent gouging and its effect on tourism. Also features nightlife and entertainment listings and advertisements for clubs and shows, along with home modernization content tied to the National Housing Act/Federal Housing Administration and other local commercial advertising.
